# Conduct

Conduct is a Software Development company. Conduct is an AI operating system for enterprise software that helps IT teams understand, modernize, and run their enterprise systems with AI. Conduct employs 63 people (+250.0% YoY, +45 people). Headquartered in London, United Kingdom. Its workforce is distributed across 5 countries (including United Kingdom, Germany, United States, France, and India).

## About

Conduct’s mission is to make IT the innovation powerhouse of every company.

Our agentic AI delivers an in-depth understanding of legacy enterprise software. For the first time ever, you can chat directly with your systems to resolve major business issues in days instead of months.

We’re starting where it matters most: SAP, the OS of global business.

# Office of Congressional Conduct (Previously the Office of Congressional Ethics)

Office of Congressional Conduct (Previously the Office of Congressional Ethics) is a government agency. The Office of Congressional Conduct is a government organization that provides various resources and information related to public reports, investigations, and press advisory. Office of Congressional Conduct (Previously the Office of Congressional Ethics) employs 7 people (+16.7% YoY, +1 person), founded in 2008. Headquartered in Washington, District of Columbia, United States.

## About

The Office of Congressional Conduct (OCC) — known prior to January 2025 as the Office of Congressional Ethics — is an independent, non-partisan entity charged with investigating allegations of misconduct against Members, officers, and staff of the United States House of Representatives and, when appropriate, referring matters to the House Committee on Ethics. In all but one set of circumstances, the report and findings of the OCC Board must be publicly released.
